result.justification: The study has a clear objective to explore participants' experiences and perceived effects of discussion groups, supported by a detailed methodology using focus groups and qualitative analysis.

objective_evidence.quote: This qualitative study aims to describe the lived experience of women participating in the 'Maternity and Cultures' discussion group.

method_evidence.quote: We used Interpretative Phenomenological Analysis (Smith, 2003) complemented by discourse and content analysis (Braun, 2006, Paillé, 2016).
